clue.text: Recently appointed during Advent

parts.note: during means in, as in 'in the meantime'
an advent is an arrival or coming

explanation.surface: Someone took up a new post in the weeks before Christmas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advent' looks like the church season before Christmas, but here it is simply a coming or arrival.
explanation.definitionFit: An incoming official is one newly taking up office.

clue.text: Spare Rib's nice enough to provide a written dedication

indicators.note: spare, as in 'go spare', means wild or frantic, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: the word rib with its s kept as a letter

explanation.surface: An issue of the feminist magazine Spare Rib is good enough to sign.
explanation.walkthrough: Spare Rib was a British feminist magazine (1972-93); 'Spare' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To inscribe a book is to write a dedication in it.

clue.text: Very important constabulary, one which reinforces state?

indicators.note: reinforces suggests strengthening from inside, so the police piece sits within the state

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state
RUC is the Royal Ulster Constabulary, the former Northern Ireland police force
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: The police force is vital because it props up the state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'which reinforces' puts RUC + I inside CAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something crucial is decisive or essential.

clue.text: Remains preserved underground about three thousand years?

definitions.text: Remains preserved underground about three thousand years?

parts.words: Remains preserved underground about three thousand years?
parts.note: describes an embalmed Egyptian body kept in a tomb for millennia

explanation.surface: Archaeologists find ancient remains kept beneath the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: An embalmed corpse wrapped in bandages, as in ancient Egypt, survived intact in tombs for millennia.

clue.text: Sandy's lousy for a start when it comes to what's important

indicators.note: for a start places the lice-ridden word at the front

parts.note: lousy literally means infested with lice, as is someone nitty, full of nits
gritty means sandy; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: Sandy is useless at first at getting down to essentials.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sandy' looks like a person's name but means full of grit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the basic essentials or practical details of a matter.

clue.text: Into craft, a poet's penning first of odes

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, as a pen holds animals, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a bard is a poet; the 's stands for 'is', joining it to penning

indicators.note: first of picks out the opening letter of the word odes

explanation.surface: A poet writes odes while setting out on a voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penning' puts O (the first letter of 'odes') inside BARD, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: To go aboard is to go onto a ship or other vessel, so the phrase stands for boarding a craft.

clue.text: Street trader in pub brawl — wow!

parts.note: a bar is a pub
a row is a noisy quarrel or brawl
'boy!' is an exclamation of surprise, like 'wow!'

explanation.surface: A market seller gets into a fight at a pub, to everyone's amazement.
explanation.walkthrough: A barrow boy is a British street trader selling fruit or veg from a handcart.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a vendor sells goods from a wheeled cart on the street.

clue.text: A serious moral failing, squeezing another when cleaned out?

definitions.text: A serious moral failing, squeezing another when cleaned out?

indicators.note: squeezing means holding tightly inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a vice is a moral fault

indicators.note: cleaned out means emptied, leaving only the outside letters of another

explanation.surface: Greed is a grave sin, grabbing from someone already left penniless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squeezing' puts AR (another emptied of its middle) inside A + VICE; the whole clue also describes greed.
explanation.definitionFit: Greed is one of the seven deadly sins, which squeezes others for gain.

clue.text: Excavator revealing some blood-red gemstones

indicators.note: revealing some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A digging machine turns up a few deep red jewels.
explanation.definitionFit: A dredge is a machine for scooping mud and silt from the bottom of rivers and harbours.

clue.text: Partner starts to usher lady in as game's ending

indicators.note: in tells us the pair of opening letters goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: as and so both mean 'in the way that' or 'therefore'
mate, as in checkmate, ends a game of chess

indicators.note: starts to picks the opening letters of usher and lady

explanation.surface: A partner is shown to a seat as a match finishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts UL (the first letters of 'usher' and 'lady') inside SO + MATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A soulmate is a perfectly suited life partner or companion.

clue.text: Film from European country being broadcast

indicators.note: being broadcast means spoken over the air, so we want a word sounding like the country

parts.note: Greece is a country in southern Europe

explanation.surface: A film from a European nation goes out on television.
explanation.definitionFit: Grease is the 1978 musical movie starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John.

clue.text: Wet at home, with little sunshine about

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: a ray is a thin beam, a small amount of sunshine
in means at home, as in 'staying in'

explanation.surface: A damp day indoors with hardly any sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainy weather is wet weather, with showers falling.

clue.text: Yolk in egg ultimately showing signs of age?

parts.note: the yolk of an egg is also called its yellow

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word egg

explanation.surface: Someone examines the yolk of an egg that looks rather old.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper, teeth and old photographs turn yellowish as they age, so yellowing marks the passing years.

clue.text: Method of reproducing op art, highly decorative

indicators.note: decorative suggests the letters are ornamentally rearranged

explanation.surface: A printing technique makes op art look very ornamental.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithography is a printmaking process using a flat stone or plate to make copies.

clue.text: Level area where cannon will be effective

definitions.text: Level area where cannon will be effective

parts.words: Level area where cannon will be effective
parts.note: seems a flat battlefield for artillery, but a cannon is also a shot in billiards striking two balls in one go

explanation.surface: Flat ground is chosen as the best place for artillery.
explanation.walkthrough: In billiards a cannon is a stroke where the cue ball hits both other balls; the table must be perfectly level.
explanation.definitionFit: The game is played on a perfectly flat baize surface, the place where such shots are made.

clue.text: In Britain tea that is brewed will be drunk

indicators.note: brewed suggests stewing things together, so the letters are mixed

parts.note: Br is an abbreviation for British or Britain
ie is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for 'that is'

explanation.surface: Tea made in Britain will be consumed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' looks like 'consumed' after tea, but means intoxicated.
explanation.definitionFit: Inebriate as an adjective means intoxicated by alcohol.

clue.text: People thinking of a number, the first one coming into their heads?

definitions.text: People thinking of a number, the first one coming into their heads?

parts.words: People thinking of a number, the first one coming into their heads?
parts.note: seems to describe a party trick of picking a number, but describes those who always think of number one, themselves

explanation.surface: People asked to think of a number pick whichever occurs to them first.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-centred people put themselves, 'number one', first in their thoughts.

clue.text: Process involved in producing the current breakdown

definitions.text: Process involved in producing the current breakdown

parts.words: Process involved in producing the current breakdown
parts.note: seems to be about the present collapse of something, but describes splitting a compound chemically by passing an electric current through it

explanation.surface: Someone explains how the present collapse came about.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrolysis decomposes a substance using electricity, a current causing chemical decomposition.

clue.text: Moderate sort of fee, as here

indicators.note: to sort is to rearrange, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A reasonable kind of charge, like this one.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease off is to lessen or slacken, to become less intense.

clue.text: Where chamber music's played using form of sordino?

indicators.note: form of means a different shape of the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Quartets play in a room, with a mute fitted to the strings.
explanation.walkthrough: A sordino is a mute for a stringed instrument, apt in a chamber-music surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Chamber music was written for performance in a room, inside a house rather than outdoors.

clue.text: Promotion? A soldier gets nothing, being slow

parts.note: an ad, short for advertisement, is a promotion
taken as written
GI is an American soldier
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A soldier gets no promotion because he is too slow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Promotion' looks like a rise in rank but means advertising.
explanation.definitionFit: Adagio is the musical direction for a leisurely tempo.

clue.text: Craft shown by the goddess Kali?

definitions.meaning: a craft is a vessel; here a fast naval warship
the Hindu goddess Kali is known as the one who annihilates evil

explanation.surface: A vessel seems to be revealed by a Hindu deity.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast warship of the navy carries this name, and Kali is worshipped as a bringer of annihilation.

clue.text: Washer which fits underneath

parts.note: seems to be a small plumbing ring placed below a nut, but describes a low basin for cleaning one's bottom

explanation.surface: A plumber describes a ring that goes below a bolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A bidet is a low bathroom basin used for washing the lower body.

clue.text: Writer philosophical as not a single taxi turned up

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means read from the bottom, so the pieces go backwards

parts.note: no means not a single, as in 'no taxi'
a cab is a taxi

explanation.surface: A thoughtful author finds no cab arrived.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses NOCAB. Francis Bacon (1561-1626) was an English philosopher and essayist.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Bacon wrote essays and works of philosophy such as Novum Organum.

clue.text: See ball go round and round

indicators.note: round suggests turning about, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Watch a ball spinning over and over.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'round' signals the anagram of BALL GO; the second is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something global is shaped like a globe, that is spherical.

clue.text: Very large headgear sent back to meet debts

indicators.note: sent back means the word for headgear is turned round

parts.note: caps are a kind of headgear
IOUs are written acknowledgments of debts, from 'I owe you'

explanation.surface: Hats are returned to settle what is owed.
explanation.definitionFit: A spacious room is roomy, with plenty of space.

clue.text: Old fellows prepared to provide compensation

parts.note: F is an abbreviation for fellow; doubled letters stand for a plural
set means prepared, as in 'all set'

explanation.surface: Elderly members of a college agree to pay damages.
explanation.definitionFit: An offset is something that balances or counteracts a loss, a counterbalance.

clue.text: Unfortunately New York shop is going under

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A Manhattan store sadly goes bankrupt.
explanation.definitionFit: Going under is slang for being put into a trance or anaesthetised, the state a hypnotist induces.
